added_timing_scope.map_update: Memory.update only; includes initial observed-map population and each granted observation refresh.
added_timing_scope.observation_decision: ObservationController.decide only, including policy scoring/request and budget grant decision.
added_timing_scope.ordinary_astar: plan_g1_forward_facing only; excludes policy wrappers, sensors, and collision shield.

collision_queries: Only the selected non-wait action is checked; unselected action shield query count remains zero.
decision_information: Only the existing observation memory, permitted ray observations and feedback are passed to decision callbacks; no future proxy trajectory or hidden occupancy is provided.
experiment_name: Phase 2 matched 61-ray emergency safety evaluation, 800-step horizon with phase timings

g1_navigation.motion: cardinal kinematic translation with separate in-place turns
g1_navigation.pedestrian_prediction: motion inferred only from observed first-hit cells; no simulator schedule or future positions
g1_navigation.retreat_eligibility: recent single-cluster pedestrian detections in two observations indicate imminent approach; entire backward sweep observed free, otherwise wait
g1_navigation.sidestep_eligibility: around a measured persistent obstacle, or one lateral escape from a close observed pedestrian threat; complete swept clearance observed free and only the selected action is shield-checked
g1_navigation.turn_clearance: deferred_to_selected_action_mujoco_shield; no AABB prefilter; one selected turn checked, rejection returned as planner feedback
